referee_caveats_inferred: Only three VLA epochs plus five sessions in one project, so the proper motion and variability limits are weak
ALMA non-detection is only quantified for one mosaic; limits for the other six data sets and for individual JuMBOs are not given
Chance-coincidence estimate uses a surface density from a different catalog and treats the 42 JuMBOs as independent; the radio source density is not uniform across the field
Flux-density and position extraction method is not described, and the marginal size measurement has PA uncertainty of 89 deg
